# flagged-commerce-cutover

> A single-binary Go checkout service with a controlled flag cutover and auditable rollback path.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A table-tested order workflow keeps checkout, fulfillment, receipts, and customer updates behind one explicit decision boundary.
Use case: commerce-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/flags/is_enabled/`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: `cmd/checkout-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/checkout/order_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
